description: Install dependencies for both mobile and web apps to establish a working baseline before making changes.
steps: Run cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/mobile && bun install to install mobile dependencies
Run cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/web && bun install to install web dependencies
Run cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/mobile && npx expo lint to verify mobile lint passes
Run cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/web && npm run lint to verify web lint passes
Run cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/web && npm run build to verify web build passes
acceptance_criteria: bun install succeeds in both apps/mobile/ and apps/web/
npx expo lint exits with 0 in apps/mobile/
npm run lint exits with 0 in apps/web/
npm run build exits with 0 in apps/web/
